suppress.notes: file name: git_cliff-2.14.2.dist-info/METADATA git-cliff is a changelog generator, not Git. It is mistaken for Git 2.14.2 because of the version number.
file name: sqlalchemy/dialects/mysql/__init__.py SQLAlchemy's MySQL dialect is mistaken for the MySQL server. We don't use MySQL.
file name: opentelemetry_api-1.45.1.dist-info/METADATA The CVE only affects opentelemetry-js (Node.js), not the Python package.

file name: .venv/Scripts/python.exe, .venv/Scripts/pythonw.exe These CVEs only affect the pre-releases 3.15.0a1 to 3.15.0b3 and are fixed in 3.15.0. Dependency-Check ignores the pre-release part of the version.
